description: This file defines the PrayerTimesRepository class, which handles fetching prayer times data from an external API (Aladhan), caching it locally, and providing prayer times for a specific city, date, and calculation method. It also manages user preferences related to prayer times.

classes.name: PrayerTimesRepository
classes.description: A repository class responsible for fetching, caching, and retrieving prayer times data from the Aladhan API, incorporating user preferences.

methods.name: getTodayPrayerTimes
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches today's prayer times for a given city, method, and school, attempting to retrieve from cache on failure.

methods.name: toPrayerTimes
methods.description: Extension function converting API response data to PrayerTimes data class.

methods.name: cachePrayerTimes
methods.description: Stores prayer times in shared preferences cache.

methods.name: getCachedPrayerTimes
methods.description: Retrieves prayer times from cache if available.

methods.name: cacheKey
methods.description: Generates a unique cache key based on city, method, and school.

methods.name: currentSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current user-selected city, calculation method, and madhab school from preferences.
